Hi Samira — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, then next steps below.

1) Period boundaries: Our SOC 2 Type II report covers the period February 1, 2025 through January 31, 2026. In practice the auditor collects continuous evidence and also captures point-in-time artifacts for certain controls. For operational evidence that is timestamped, we treat the end date as inclusive of the full calendar day (we typically model "through 2026-01-31 23:59:59 UTC" for controls that use daily snapshots). However, some attest procedures rely on auditor-selected snapshots rather than continuous logging; we can flag which control families were snapshot-based.

2) Bridge letter: We can obtain a bridge letter that extends coverage through Feb 28, 2026. Auditors usually provide a short letter that either (a) states the report covers through Jan 31 inclusive and separately confirms no material control changes through the requested bridge period, or (b) provides a limited statement of operations during the bridge window. We will ask the auditor to adopt explicit language about the Jan 31 inclusivity if that is helpful for your mapping.

Next steps: I'm looping in our external auditor (Bluebridge) to confirm exact snapshot timing language and turnaround. I attached the finalized report we have on file for your reference. If you prefer a specific phrasing for the bridge letter (e.g., "inclusive through 2026-01-31 23:59:59 UTC"), please reply and we'll request that exact wording.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf

Thanks,
Priya

Hi Priya/Samira,

Thanks for the clear note. Bluebridge can provide the requested bridge letter. A few clarifications:

• Snapshot timing: For log-based and automation controls we typically obtain daily evidence captures. Our manifest shows these as taken at 23:59:59 UTC when the customer environment supports consistent UTC timestamps. If Redwood's logs are in a different timezone we convert to UTC for the report artifacts and will state that conversion.

• Wording and inclusivity: We can include explicit language in the bridge letter. Example phrasing options we can provide (choose one):
  1) "The controls described in the report were operating effectively through January 31, 2026 (inclusive), with evidence captured up to and including 2026-01-31 23:59:59 UTC."
  2) "The report covers the period February 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026; selected control evidence was obtained via auditor-selected snapshots. The auditor did not perform continuous sampling beyond the stated period."

• Turnaround & fee: Standard turnaround is 3 business days from request and receipt of a fee authorization. Typical fee for a bridge letter with limited additional procedures is $1,200 USD. If you need expedited same-day language, that incurs an extra charge.

If Samira confirms option 1 (inclusive phrasing), we will draft the letter and send a DocuSign envelope; please advise and we will proceed.

Regards,
